name: What are the most effective ways to maximize space in a small bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What are the most effective ways to maximize space in a small bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: To maximize space in a small bathroom, consider incorporating wall-mounted fixtures like a floating vanity or toilet to free up floor space. Installing a corner sink or a trough sink can also be space-efficient. Opt for a curbless shower with a clear glass enclosure to create an open feel. Recessed medicine cabinets, built-in shelving, and pocket doors are also excellent solutions for optimizing storage and usable space without clutter.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maximize space in a small bathroom by using wall-mounted fixtures, corner sinks, curbless showers, recessed storage, and pocket doors.
